section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: 25 ## Means Adopted to commit Suicides : A study of suicide cases according to the ‘Means Adopted’ for committing suicides revealed that the majority of persons commit suicide by taking poison and 22·5 percent of the total suicides were committed by this method during 1979. The other important ‘means used’ for committing suicides were ‘Hanging’ (22·0%), ‘Drowning’ (20·9%), ‘Railways’ (6·8%), ‘Fire’ (6·7%), ‘Jumping’ (1·4%), ‘Firearms’ (1·0%), ‘Weapons’ (0·8%) and ‘Machine’ (0·7%) while 17·2 percent of the total suicides registered during 1979 was shared by the suicides grouped under ‘Other causes’. The details are presented in Table-IV.
